falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 4,650 on any day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 2020 Dec breakout pattern requires a sustained grind higher from compressed volatility; an immediate breach of the upper resistance invalidates the analog's timing and trajectory, proving the 76% pattern match was a false positive

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 12.00 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score of 50 with collapsing volatility would signal complacency rather than the tension-release dynamic of the 2020 pattern; this would prove the breakout is not imminent and the HOLD signal was premature

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades above 4,600
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 2020 Dec breakout occurred with rates rising (reflation rotation); a risk-off bond rally with equities near highs would indicate a different macro regime entirely, invalidating the transition framework

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
